stemMarkdown: In what ratio must a solution containing 30% acid be mixed with a solution containing 78% acid to obtain a mixture that is 61% acid? Give the ratio (cheaper : dearer) in simplest form, e.g. '3:2'.
solutionMarkdown: By alligation: $\dfrac{\text{cheaper}}{\text{dearer}} = \dfrac{y - z}{z - x} = \dfrac{78 - 61}{61 - 30} = \dfrac{17}{31} = 17:31$ (after simplifying by dividing both terms by 1).
